verdict.rationale: CoreWeave documents API Access Tokens that grant access to resources such as CKS clusters and VPCs. It also documents exchanging a token for temporary AI Object Storage credentials, with bucket policies that can restrict principals by group membership. That is a narrow, storage-only form of scoped, short-lived credential, not general least-privilege token issuance for an agent. Missing for 10: documented per-token permission scopes or roles, least-privilege restriction of API tokens across services (CKS, Inference, VPC), agent or service-account credential guidance, and any independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
